adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler does a non-atomic read-then-write: `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId, appId } })` followed by either `credential.update` or `credential.create`. With concurrent webhook deliveries for the same `(userId, appId)`, both requests can observe “no credential” and both attempt `create`, which can produce duplicate credentials (if no DB uniqueness) or trigger a failing create (if there is a unique constraint). The race is directly present in the diff because there’s no transaction/locking or upsert on a unique key.
